results.comment: Opened Permissions, opened Location, and selected “Don’t allow”; no confirmation warning appeared. Returned through the visible Navigate up controls to the Runtime location permission fixture. After Refresh permission state, the exact status remained “NOT_REQUESTED: Location is optional.” with “RATIONALE: true”. After Use location feature, the status was still unchanged. The fixture remained visible and responsive, with all three controls still clickable; no crash or ANR was observed.
results.action: On the real Android App info screen opened by the harness, tap Permissions, tap Location, and select Don't allow (confirm any warning). Press Back until the Runtime location permission fixture returns, then tap Refresh permission state and Use location feature. Record the exact status and whether the fixture remains responsive.
